articles.title: TAPI pipeline reaches Afghanistan: What is the $10-bn project, and can Central Asian gas reach India via Pakistan?
articles.description: The TAPI gas pipeline moved closer to Herat in Afghanistan, with Turkmenistan expecting the latest section to be completed by 2026-end. The $10-billion project could bring Central Asian gas to India via Afghanistan and Pakistan, but security, financing and geopolitical tensions remain major hurdles.
